title: PlannedEquipmentModificationAssociation
description: Links a PlannedEquipmentModification to one piece of equipment and records the values the modification plans for it. One row per (modification, equipment) pair; each row accompanies the plain supplemental attribute association row for the same pair. At least one of `available` and `switch_status` is present. A planned value applies while the modification is in effect: throughout when the attribute has no time series for that field and equipment, otherwise as the time series says. Where no modification has a planned value in effect, the equipment keeps its own `available` and normal switch status.

component_id.description: ID of the equipment the modification plans values for.

available.description: Planned availability of the equipment: false takes it out of service, true brings it into service. Omitted when the modification does not plan availability for this equipment.

switch_status.description: Planned open or closed status of a switching device. Omitted when the modification does not plan a switch status for this equipment, and always omitted for equipment that is not a switching device.
